text:
harry_partnerships: quick thread  BridgeKey (SI) asked about a Marketplace bundle pairing Redwood Private + BridgeKey HSM-backed secrets. They want: SAML SSO example, SCIM provisioning, and a KMS/HSM key-wrap demo (PKCS#11 preferred). Need a short integration runbook + smoke script by EOW for their webinar. @yuki_eng @rami_security can we take this?

yuki_eng: I can own the E2E smoke. Need to confirm if BridgeKey wants an on-prem PKCS#11 connector or KMIP proxy. Also: will they supply a dev HSM endpoint?

harry_partnerships: BridgeKey said they can provide a lab HSM (PKCS#11 socket) and a KMIP proxy if needed. Timeline: webinar next Thursday.

rami_security: treat as BYOK for Private. Require CA thumbprint checks for KMIP and TLS validation for PKCS#11 tunnel. Add a short threat-model note around HSM operator privileges and cross-tenant ACLs. No real certs in docs.

laura_sales: BridgeKey will provision a dev tenant + lab HSM socket and test creds. They asked for an integration checklist so engineers can prep service accounts and SAML metadata.

yuki_eng: Plan: 1) exchange SAML metadata + signed assertion sample, 2) SCIM token + incremental group sync, 3) PKCS#11 wrap/unwrap demo against lab HSM, fallback KMIP proxy flow, 4) call Redwood rotate API to validate. I'll post minimal commands and a tiny smoke script.

yuki_eng: SCIM token example:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://dev.bridgekey.example/scim/token -d '{"client_id":"bk-dev","client_secret":"REDACTED"}'
```

yuki_eng: rotate sample (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private-api.staging.redwood-inference.local/v1/secrets/rotate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>' \
  -d '{"secret_id":"bk-demo","kms_key_id":"pkcs11://hsm-slot-1/key-abc"}'
```

ci-bot: CI job #bridgekey-integ smoke completed  6 tests, 1 flaky (SCIM pagination). logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/alg/4321 :white_check_mark:

yuki_eng: flaky due to SCIM paging on large groups. switching to incremental sync with backoff and idempotency header. will push script Tue EOD.

rami_security: include idempotency guidance, CA thumbprint verification steps, and a rollback play: revert to prior wrap key + mark secrets read-only until manual verification. Also limit service token TTLs in the checklist.

nate_pm: I can draft the 1-pager + 3-slide deck if eng provides commands and 2 sanitized screenshots by Wed.

harry_partnerships: action items: Yuki (E2E smoke + script) Tue EOD; Nate (runbook + slides) Wed EOD; Laura (partner dev tenant & lab HSM creds) Wed AM; Rami (security blurb + threat-model & rollback) Wed EOD. Marketing wants final assets Thu for rehearsal.

laura_sales: nudging BridgeKey now for lab socket and test creds.

yuki_eng: temp repo with scripts: https://git.internal/redwood/bridgekey-integ (internal). will sanitize before external share.

harry_partnerships: perfect  we'll consolidate into the runbook. thanks team :rocket:
